english.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a sofa or couch.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for an upholstered sofa.
This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese word for a sofa or settee.

examples.english: This couch is really comfortable, and three people can sit on it without feeling cramped.
examples.traditional: 呢張梳化好舒服，坐三個人都唔迫。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa2 hou2 syu1 fuk6 zo6 saam1 go3 jan4 dou1 m4 bik1

examples.english: The sofa is really comfortable to sit on.
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 so1 faa2 co5 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6

examples.english: We sat on the settee watching television.
examples.traditional: 我哋坐喺梳化度睇電視。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 co5 hai2 so1 faa2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6
